mission: The group turns the breach into a plan: Veraine is engineering the collapse, Veranthos is the key, and Ben takes the room by assembling the right read.
why_now: Post-midpoint. Part 3 opens. Ben's body-knowledge from the breach needs to arrive in the room as language so the group can operate on it. The array-dependency is the decision-forcing fact that reroutes every chapter from here to Ch 20. Sera has to offer him something she does not yet realise she is offering in the pattern of how she offers it — and Ben has to receive it while the blank Luke template sits unfilled on the table.
conflict: Ben takes the room by assembling the facts, not by asserting rank. Naming Veraine as engineer rather than student means committing to an intercept route and accepting that the institutional chain-of-command he would normally loop in is now, specifically, not looped in. Sera accepts his authority conditionally. That is also the sentence she said a thousand years ago to the last commander she trusted, and she cannot yet see the rhyme. On Ben's datapad, the report template sits with its mission-state field blank — every sentence he tries to put in it would be a version of the conversation he just had, and none of the versions are complete.
turning_point: Sera shifts from adversarial to subordinate and calls Ben 'Skywalker' with something new inside the word — investment, not warmth. The gift is also the test. Meanwhile, the Luke report template sits open on the briefing table with the mission-state field empty; Desh sees it, Ben sees Desh see it, neither speaks.
opening_hook: Ben stands in the center of the common area and lays out the plan — Veraine as engineer, not student; the array-dependency at Veranthos; the intercept route. His mother's voice in his cadence without him meaning it to be
closing_hook: Sera calls him 'Skywalker' with something that wasn't there before. Not warmth — investment. She has chosen to follow him. The last person she chose to follow sealed her in a wall. The Luke report template is still open on the briefing table with the mission-state field blank
emotional_trajectory: Assumed authority -> the intellectual naming landing in the room -> the test of command -> the burden of earned trust -> the unfilled template

stakes.personal: Ben assuming a leadership role he is not sure he deserves; the unfilled report template as the continuing expression of the Ch 13 withholding
stakes.interpersonal: Sera's trust is a gift and a warning — it places Gavran's shadow on Ben without Ben naming it
stakes.external: The strategy to intercept Veraine must work or they lose the race; the array-dependency fact makes Veranthos the specific destination that determines the endgame shape

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — common area reconfigured as tactical briefing space
sensory_details: Desh's tactical displays showing the intercept route overlaid on the Corridor map; Sera's posture shifting — spine straightening, feet resettling; Torin nodding with an approval that should feel reassuring and does not; Kael against the wall, arms crossed, evaluating; Ben's datapad open on the table corner with the Luke report template glowing, mission-state field blank
canon_elements_needed: Jedi Order mission report template structure
Luke Skywalker's standing comm protocols with field Jedi
action_beats: Ben stands in the center of the common area and names what Veraine has been doing — engineering, not studying. The word lands in the room

Ben lays out the array-dependency fact as the decision-forcing conclusion that reroutes the mission: Veranthos is the specific completion site; the intercept route skips ahead of her rather than following
Sera straightens her spine and shifts her posture from adversarial to subordinate — a soldier accepting command
Kael leans against the wall with arms crossed, evaluating Ben's plan from the outside
Ben opens a new Luke report template on his datapad before the briefing begins; it sits open through the scene with the mission-state field blank
Desh's eyes find the open template on the briefing-table corner as the scene closes. Neither speaks
notes: Keep it tactical. Sera's line to Ben should change the room, and the unfinished report should remain visible as the cost of that new authority.

turning_point_detail.trigger: Sera straightens her spine and calls Ben 'Skywalker' with something new inside the word — investment, not warmth. She has chosen to follow him.
turning_point_detail.shift: The gift is also the test. The Luke report template sits open on the briefing table with the mission-state field empty. Desh sees it. Ben sees Desh see it. Neither speaks. The institutional silence becomes a presence.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben assumes a leadership role he is not certain he deserves. The unfilled report template continues the Ch 13 withholding and makes it visible to the group. Sera's trust places Gavran's shadow on Ben without either of them naming it — a thousand-year-old pattern of command and sealed walls that Ben cannot yet see in the rhyme of her acceptance.

emotional_arc.start: Assumed authority — Ben feels the weight of decision-making settle into his body without permission or rank to justify it.
emotional_arc.shift: The intellectual naming lands in the room and tightens into focus. Sera's acceptance arrives as both gift and test. The blank report template becomes visible as the cost of his new authority.
emotional_arc.end: The unfilled template — Ben carries forward the burden of earned trust and the institutional silence that comes with it. The pressure settles into his chest as something he will not yet name.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben stands in the center of the common area and names Veraine's activity as engineering, not studying. The word lands in the room as a structural reframing.
key_beats.state_change: Abstract pressure crystallizes into concrete antagonist action. The group's reactive posture shifts toward strategic response.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben feels assumed authority settle into his shoulders and chest — an instinct that pushes toward action and declaration rather than explanation or permission-seeking. His mother's cadence surfaces in his voice without deliberate choice.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben lays out the array-dependency fact: the seal's structural integrity depends on Veranthos as the completion site. The intercept route skips ahead of Veraine's dismantling sequence rather than following it.
key_beats.state_change: The mission reroutes. Veranthos becomes the decision-forcing destination that determines endgame shape. The group moves from damage-control to intercept strategy.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's focus tightens on the intellectual naming — the moment when disparate facts align into a single conclusion that changes everything. His breath steadies. The pressure that was diffuse becomes directional.

key_beats.beat_description: Sera straightens her spine, feet resettling. Her posture shifts from adversarial stance to soldier's readiness — the physical grammar of accepting command.
key_beats.state_change: Sera moves from conditional skepticism to conditional subordination. The room registers her choice as a turning point.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben sees the shift in her spine and recognizes it as acceptance — not warmth, not agreement, but investment. The recognition lands with weight because he understands what it costs her. His chest tightens with the knowledge that she is choosing to follow him, and that choice carries the shadow of Gavran without either of them naming it.

key_beats.beat_description: Kael leans against the wall with arms crossed, evaluating Ben's plan from the outside. His posture remains unchanged — neither endorsement nor rejection, but assessment.
key_beats.state_change: The scene pivots from Ben's assertion to the group's reception. Kael's outsider perspective remains unresolved, holding the plan in tension.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben registers Kael's evaluation as a test he is passing or failing in real time. The pressure of being read by someone outside the institutional chain becomes tactile — a weight in the room that Ben cannot fully account for.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben's datapad sits open on the briefing-table corner with a Luke report template glowing. The mission-state field remains blank throughout the scene. As the briefing closes, Desh's eyes find the open template. Ben sees Desh see it. Neither speaks.
key_beats.state_change: The unfilled report becomes visible as the cost of Ben's new authority. The institutional silence — the fact that Luke is not being looped in — becomes a presence in the room.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben feels the weight of the blank field as a continuation of the Ch 13 withholding. The moment Desh's eyes find the template, Ben knows that the cost of Sera's trust is now visible to someone else. His instinct is to close the datapad, but he does not. The blank field remains open. The pressure settles into his chest as something he will carry forward.

anti_patterns: Keep it tactical — do not drift into introspective meditation on leadership or authority.
Do not arrive at clinical articulation of the array-dependency mechanics — keep the explanation tactical and concrete.
Sera's line to Ben should change the room through its delivery and what it signals, not through explicit emotional language.
